title: Berserk

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Berserk is a status effect granted by wearing all three pieces of the Bear Set.
It gives:
• +30% Health regeneration
• +15% Stamina regeneration
• Slightly weak (+25% damage taken) vs Blunt, Slash and Pierce
• +10% Slash damage
• +10% Chop damage
